name: Community Bancshares, Inc.
summary: Community Bancshares, Inc. delivers a comprehensive array of financial solutions throughout Ohio. The company accepts diverse forms of deposits, including checking, savings, term certificates, individual retirement accounts (IRAs), and certificates of deposit. For lending needs, it offers residential mortgage, business and commercial, installment, and personal loans. Beyond these core offerings, the firm also issues debit, credit, and gift cards, and facilitates bond transactions. Its extensive suite of services further encompasses merchant support, payroll processing, remote deposit capture, online and mobile banking functionalities, express drop, notary services, safe deposit boxes, and convenient check re-ordering. The institution operates a network of 16 branch locations and 19 ATMs, primarily serving customers in Vinton, Ross, Fairfield, Hocking, Pickaway, Franklin, and their contiguous counties. Founded in 1867, Community Bancshares, Inc. is headquartered in McArthur, Ohio.
